title: Coop Add-On Requirements
description: A set of requirements for cooperative Add-On projects. See https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/practices/guidelinesforbuildingcooperativeaddons for more info.

101.title: No Loose Files
101.description: In a cooperative Add-On, there should not be any 'loose files' - e.g., <pack>/entities/this_is_a_loose_file.json - inside of a folder.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path of the loose file found

102.title: No Common Folder Names
102.description: Creator folders - e.g., <pack>/entities/<custom folder name> - should not be a 'common' name. It should probably be in the form <creator_short_name>_<game_shortName>. See attached list of creator names.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the forbidden common folder name used

104.title: Loose Creator File
104.description: Cooperative Add-Ons should not have loose files directly in creator folders.
104.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path of the loose file found

108.title: Multiple Creator Folders
108.description: Found more than one folder in creator folder besides common shared folders.
108.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the folder names found

109.title: Unsupported Folder Name
109.description: Type folder contains unsupported subfolder names that don't follow cooperative Add-On conventions.
109.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the unsupported folder name

110.title: Multiple Type Folders
110.description: Found more than one folder in the type folder, which may indicate naming convention issues.
110.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the folder names found

111.title: Loose Type Files
111.description: Type folders should not contain loose files in cooperative Add-Ons.
111.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path of the loose file found

131.title: No Dimension Elements
131.description: Cooperative Add-Ons should not contain dimension-related elements.
131.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the dimension element path found

133.title: No UI Elements
133.description: Cooperative Add-Ons should not contain custom UI elements.
133.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the UI element path found

160.title: BP Manifest Missing
160.description: Expected exactly one behavior pack manifest.json but found none or multiple.
160.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count of manifests found

161.title: RP Manifest Missing
161.description: Expected exactly one resource pack manifest.json but found none or multiple.
161.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count of manifests found

163.title: RP Manifest Count
163.description: Expected exactly one resource pack manifest.json but found incorrect count.
163.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count of manifests found

164.title: BP Manifest Invalid
164.description: The behavior pack manifest.json file is not valid or cannot be parsed.
164.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the validation error message

165.title: BP-RP Dependency Missing
165.description: Expected exactly one dependency from behavior pack to resource pack but found none or multiple.
165.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the dependency count found

166.title: BP-RP Dependency Invalid
166.description: The dependency from behavior pack to resource pack is not valid.
166.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the validation error message

168.title: RP-BP Dependency Missing
168.description: Expected exactly one dependency from resource pack to behavior pack but found none or multiple.
168.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the dependency count found

169.title: RP-BP Dependency Invalid
169.description: The dependency from resource pack to behavior pack is not valid.
169.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the validation error message
